$note: Sound-effect library. Generate each once with `npm run audio`, then reuse it in every episode. `licensed` is true only for original work or paid-plan ElevenLabs output. Final renders require it.

chomp.prompt: a big loud crunchy bite into a crisp fresh apple, very crunchy and snappy with crackling texture, teeth crunch, close-up and dry, cartoon punchy, no music, no voice

pop.prompt: a soft bubbly user-interface pop, short and clean, friendly, no reverb

whoosh.prompt: a quick airy swoosh for a video transition, clean, short, no music

warning.prompt: a short gentle two-note warning blip, digital, friendly, not harsh

error.prompt: a short cartoonish error buzz, low and quick, playful, not scary

success.prompt: a bright short success ding with a tiny sparkle, cheerful user interface sound

tick.prompt: fast soft mechanical counter ticking, like a scoreboard rolling up, clean

swoosh-up.prompt: a short rising swoosh, camera zooming in, airy and clean
